facts: The community association developed a self-guided walk supported by Hobart City Council and Tasmanian Community Fund. Location: footer.
The walk covers historic places between Salamanca Place and Hampden Road, including Arthur Circus, Narryna, Princes Park and Kelly Street. Location: walk description and Locations.
